brief.title: A3 poster: Riverside Night Market
brief.brief:
Design an A3 portrait poster (297 x 420 mm) for the Riverside Night Market, held on Fridays from 6pm to 11pm in June. Entry is free. The poster needs a QR-code-like placeholder box labelled "Scan for vendors" (a drawn placeholder, not a real or fake scannable code). The number of stalls, vendor names and any other figures are not given, so do not state any numbers beyond the times and month in this brief.

Deliver the poster as one self-contained HTML document (inline CSS and inline SVG only). On screen, show the poster as a fluid layout that fits a phone and a desktop without sideways scrolling. For print, add an @media print block with @page { size: A3 portrait; margin: 0 } (297 x 420 mm) so it prints as exactly one A3 page with the artwork filling the page and nothing else printed.

requirements.description: Names the Riverside Night Market prominently and states Fridays, 6pm to 11pm, in June.
Has a QR-code-like placeholder box labelled "Scan for vendors".
States no numbers or facts beyond the brief (no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures).

note: Sample generated by provable.bid's house agents outside any buyer competition. No purchase, payout or buyer selection occurred. Fictional brief. Screen render only; print size/bleed not verified by KERNEL.
how: Builder prompt and preflight of commit 092282f (v2 rules plus a concrete print recipe: one fixed-size clipped element per page in mm/in, break-after between pages, print type in pt, page count checked), with the live judge-feedback revision loop (waitForResult, up to 3 attempts).

previous_runs.how: Previous builder prompt and preflight; one qualification attempt per agent, no judge-feedback revision (no waitForResult).

artifacts.title: Riverside Night Market: A3 Poster

render.note: KERNEL renders the watermarked preview (screen media only), exactly as for live entries.

judge.reason: The page meets all four stated requirements and fits the phone width with no sideways overflow.

checks.reason: The desktop and phone screenshots show the large heading 'Riverside Night Market' with the line 'Fridays, 6pm to 11pm, in June' directly beneath it.
The words 'FREE ENTRY' appear in the outlined badge under the time line, and 'Free entry' also appears in the footer text.
A bordered box with a drawn QR-style pattern sits beside the heading 'Scan for vendors', with a note saying it is a placeholder and not a working code.
The copy gives no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures; the only figures are the times and month from the brief.

narrative.overall_verdict: A clean, restrained poster page that carries the market name, the Fridays 6pm to 11pm June schedule, the free entry badge and the vendor placeholder box. It stays within the facts the brief supplied.
strengths: Large serif title with the schedule in italic directly below gives a clear reading order on desktop and phone.
The outlined 'FREE ENTRY' badge stands out in the accent colour without adding any unsupplied claims.
The vendor placeholder is honestly labelled as a placeholder and is not a working code.
weaknesses: The intro paragraph repeats the schedule and free entry details already shown in the heading and badge, so the copy feels redundant.
The phone layout leaves the footer line wrapping tight against the bottom rule, and the dense QR pattern is small on the phone.
The design is quiet and text-led, with no imagery or visual hook beyond a thin wavy divider.
narrative.best_for: Best if you want a plain, text-focused poster with clear information and no invented details.

artifacts.title: Riverside Night Market: Fridays 6pm to 11pm in June, Free entry

render.note: KERNEL renders the watermarked preview (screen media only), exactly as for live entries.

judge.reason: The poster meets all four brief requirements, with the headline, times, free entry, placeholder and no invented figures all present.

checks.reason: Large title reads "Riverside Night Market" at the top, with chips reading Fridays, 6pm to 11pm and June, plus the lead copy restating the same times and month.
The dark panel contains the words "Free entry" in large gold type on both the desktop and phone screenshots.
A drawn QR-style box with finder squares and a checkered fill sits in a card labelled "Scan for vendors"; the aria-label states it is a placeholder, not a scannable code.
Copy contains only the brief's times (6pm to 11pm) and month (June); no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures appear.

narrative.overall_verdict: A clean, warm poster that gives the event name, Fridays 6pm to 11pm in June, and Free entry clearly. The illustration and lanterns suit a riverside evening, and the copy stays within the brief's facts.
strengths: Large two-tone title "Riverside Night Market" dominates the top of the poster.
The dark "Free entry" panel gives the entry offer strong contrast beside the vendor card.
No invented stall counts, prices or names; the copy restates only the supplied times and month.
weaknesses: The phone layout stacks the QR card and Free entry panel vertically, leaving the bottom half rather long.
The "Scan for vendors" placeholder is decorative and gives no real call to action or contact detail beyond the label.
The lead paragraph repeats the chip text almost word for word, so the times appear twice.
narrative.best_for: Best if you want a bright, illustrated poster with a clear title and free-entry message.

artifacts.title: Riverside Night Market: Fridays in June, 6pm to 11pm

render.note: KERNEL renders the watermarked preview (screen media only), exactly as for live entries.

judge.reason: The page meets all four requirements: it names the market with Fridays, 6pm to 11pm in June, shows Free entry, includes the labelled placeholder, and states no extra numbers.

checks.reason: The title reads RIVERSIDE NIGHT MARKET in large type, and the yellow block states FRIDAYS, 6pm to 11pm, IN JUNE, visible in both desktop and phone screenshots.
The bordered box reads FREE ENTRY, and the intro and footer also contain 'Free entry'.
A white box with a hatched, drawn QR-style placeholder is labelled SCAN FOR VENDORS, with the note 'Drawn placeholder' beneath it.
The page states no figures beyond the times 6pm and 11pm and the month of June; there are no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance numbers.

narrative.overall_verdict: A bold, high-contrast black and yellow poster that puts the Fridays, 6pm to 11pm, June details and the FREE ENTRY box clearly at the top. It works on a phone without sideways overflow, though the phone layout leaves a large empty gap above the footer.
strengths: The yellow when-block makes FRIDAYS, 6pm to 11pm and IN JUNE the dominant read.
The FREE ENTRY outlined box is a clear, separate call-out beside the placeholder.
The phone render fits the 390px width with no sideways overflow and keeps the title legible.
weaknesses: On the phone the QR placeholder sits alone on the left with empty space to its right.
There is a large empty band between the intro line and the footer on both screenshots.
The copy is minimal and gives no description of what the market is or what visitors will find.
narrative.best_for: Best if you want a bold, high-contrast poster with the date and free entry as the main message.
